title: Ability to change backpressure boundary in `Framed`
author: crusader-mike
body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
I am using `Framed<TcpStream, ...>` and would like to be able to change backpressure boundary (which is currently hardcoded to 8kb). See [this line](https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/blob/master/tokio-util/src/codec/framed_impl.rs#L28).

Two questions on related subject:
- is there any point adding buffering between `Framed` and `TcpStream` (e.g. `Framed<BufStream<TcpStream>>`)? (I suspect no, since `Framed` has it's own r/w buffers that can be made to reserve desired space)
- is there any downside in increasing `Framed` read buffer capacity? default value of 8kb looks pretty small nowadays and leads to too many syscalls (per MB transferred)

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A simple `Framed::set_backpressure_boundary()` function will do...

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
The only alternative I see is to copy `Framed` source code to my project.
